traffic.plan.dispatching: Sending / outcome unconfirmed; no automatic resend
traffic.plan.title: Next stream suggestions and reminders
traffic.plan.intro: Suggestions use your own sessions only. Reference streamers are separate; test and unclassified data are excluded.
traffic.plan.channels: Channels (30 minutes ahead; both may be enabled)
traffic.plan.limit: Maximum reminders per streamer per week
traffic.plan.policy: Suggestions require two qualified slots for the same streamer; each needs 3 sessions on 3 dates, 30 elapsed minutes and 20 observed opening minutes. Keep the main service running. Reminders more than 5 minutes late are missed; failed sends are not retried automatically.
traffic.plan.compareNote: Opening viewers are analyzed separately by platform and streamer. Audience sizes do not establish which streamer or time is better; avoiding another streamer is not necessarily beneficial. Test data is excluded.
traffic.plan.health.title: Classification status
traffic.plan.health.profilesMissing: Account defaults: none (future sessions will not inherit)
traffic.plan.classifyNote: Historical identities are not guessed. Assign a streamer and a purpose (mine, reference or test); clearing it returns the session to unclassified. Session overrides take priority over account defaults. The list shows unclassified sessions by default; switch status to review classified ones. Classification is reversible and does not delete data. Existing platform charts above still combine all sources; use cleanup preview below for deletion.
traffic.plan.markTests: Mark unclassified sessions on this page as test
traffic.plan.backfill.title: Backfill old sessions
traffic.plan.backfill.note: 1) Choose platform, status and time range, then Preview. 2) The table shows duration, viewers, chats and joins; uncheck sessions you do not want. 3) Enter a streamer/purpose and apply. The latest batch can be undone. Only classification fields change; viewer/chat counts and session times stay untouched.
traffic.plan.backfill.useEnvHint: Uses the broadcaster identity detected from recent native events; falls back to .env.
traffic.plan.backfill.noEnvIdentity: No broadcaster identity is configured in .env for {platform}.
traffic.plan.backfill.twitchIdHint: Native Twitch events use the numeric UserID; if .env has a channel name, replace it with the UserID from the startup log.
traffic.plan.backfill.truncated: More than 50 sessions match; showing the latest 50. Narrow the range or apply in batches.
traffic.plan.backfill.batchTruncated: This batch has {total} sessions; showing the first 50. Undo still processes all of them.
traffic.plan.backfill.previewResult: {matched} sessions match; {excluded} lack viewer samples and are excluded.
traffic.plan.backfill.assignment: Enter a streamer or choose a purpose.
traffic.plan.backfill.tooMany: Too many sessions; narrow the platform or time range.
traffic.plan.backfill.error.broadcaster: Streamer cannot be blank; leave it empty to keep the current value.
traffic.plan.backfill.error.purpose: Purpose must be mine, reference or test.
traffic.plan.saveError: Could not save. Check the service connection and inputs, then retry.
traffic.plan.originError: Could not save. Open the traffic page on the main service, reload and retry.
traffic.plan.error.channels: Select at least one notification channel: ntfy or Bark.
traffic.plan.error.maxPerWeek: Weekly reminders must be an integer from 1 to 7.
traffic.plan.error.weekdays: Select at least one available weekday.
traffic.plan.error.hours: Select at least one available start hour.
traffic.plan.error.timezone: Unknown reminder timezone. Use a timezone name such as Asia/Taipei.
traffic.plan.error.channelNotConfigured: A selected channel is missing or invalid. ntfy accepts a topic name or a full URL; Bark requires a full URL.
traffic.plan.loadError: Could not load reminder data. Please reload later.
traffic.plan.disabled: Automatic reminders are off. Enable and save to schedule notifications.
traffic.plan.waiting: No upcoming suggestions. Check your streamer classification, available hours and historical coverage.
traffic.plan.collecting.title: Data collection suggestions
traffic.plan.collecting.note: Based on the last {days} days. Platforms at the same time share one reminder. These are not best-time recommendations; each week it reminds at the window start and once more at the hour if no live observation is detected.
traffic.plan.collecting.row: {sessions}/{minimum} sessions · {days}/{minDays} dates; need {need} more on different dates.
traffic.plan.collecting.more: {count} more slots; see the history page for full progress.
traffic.plan.collecting.seriesNote: Pick the weekdays; each selected day reminds at the window start and once more at the hour if no live observation is detected. Platform data is accumulated separately.
traffic.plan.collecting.seriesNeedsResta: The main service is out of date. Restart it before building a weekly plan.
traffic.plan.collecting.windowHint: Reminder time follows start confidence: exact / late uses 15 minutes before the slot; approximate / estimated uses 30 minutes. Next reminder shows the actual send time.
traffic.plan.collecting.disabled: Reminders or notification channels are not enabled; suggestions are view-only.
traffic.plan.collecting.paused: This slot is outside your available weekdays/hours; reminders are paused.
traffic.plan.collecting.auto: Reminds at the window start, with one on-time nudge if no live observation is detected, until the slot qualifies; then formal recommendations take over.
traffic.plan.error.collecting: Could not add this goal; the slot may no longer need data.
traffic.plan.error.action: The server does not support this action yet; restart the main service.
traffic.plan.sending: Sending / outcome unconfirmed; no automatic resend
traffic.plan.excluded: Excluded: missing start {missingStart} / pending {pending} / insufficient opening coverage {insufficientCoverage}.
traffic.plan.shared: Weekday/hour slots also observed in your data: {slots} (not necessarily simultaneous).
traffic.plan.slotEvidence: {slot} · {n} sessions / {days} dates · mean {mean} viewers · shrunk estimate {score} · {state}
traffic.plan.classifyFirst: Assign sessions to streamers below and classify them as your own or reference streams.
traffic.plan.broadcaster: Streamer identity (TikTok handle / Twitch user ID)
traffic.plan.sessionStats: Duration {minutes} min · avg {average}/peak {peak} · chats {chats} · joins {joins} · samples {samples}
console.title: System console
monitor.title: Live message monitor
audience.title: Regulars
audience.note: Only viewers who actually interacted are counted. Attendance, streak, active days, messages and gifts are capped so spam or spending cannot decide the level alone.
audience.loadError: Could not load. Check the service and sign-in state.
audience.formula: Score = the five component points added together, rounded to one decimal. Current score: {total}.
runtime.title: Runtime status
runtime.note: This page shows the process lifecycle. Check logs for platform login, live connections and messages; use the browser page for browser status.
runtime.description.stopped: No chat process is running. Choose platforms in startup settings.
runtime.description.starting: The server accepted the request and is waiting for the process to start.
runtime.description.running: The process has started. Check logs for platform initialization and connections.
runtime.description.stopping: Stop requested. Waiting for the process to finish cleanup.
runtime.description.failed: The process failed to start or exited unexpectedly. Check logs for details.
runtime.delayed: The process has not exited after 15 seconds. Check logs for details.
runtime.subtitle: Process lifecycle, chat sources and launch options.
runtime.sourcesNote: Shows the configured and expected source. Restart the child process after changing it.
runtime.source.browserDetail: App-managed dedicated browser; not your daily Edge.
runtime.source.manualDetail: Only reads your own Edge/Tampermonkey userscript; the app starts no source.
runtime.source.autoDetail: Auto: native with credentials, otherwise the app browser.
browser.title: TTW dedicated browser
browser.intro: Sign in to TikTok in a dedicated Chrome / Edge window. Your profile is retained across server restarts.
browser.note: A connection only means the browser is reachable. Check sign-in or verification in the browser window. You can minimize it to the taskbar; closing it disconnects the browser. The console does not close it automatically.
browser.connected: Browser connected · Check sign-in in the window
error.BROWSER_OPERATION_FAILED: Browser operation failed. Check settings or server logs
error.BROWSER_NOT_FOUND: Chrome / Edge not found. Set BROWSER_EXECUTABLE to its full path
error.BROWSER_START_TIMEOUT: Browser startup timed out. Check the profile lock and debugging port
error.TAB_CLOSED: The tab was closed. Refresh the page
runtime.optionsNote: Select platforms or features. Leave accounts blank to use existing settings. Choices are saved in this browser.
error.RUNTIME_BUSY: The process is already active or stopping
error.INVALID_START_OPTIONS: Check startup options and select at least one platform or feature
runtime.transportNote: Socket: message relay; Bark: push notifications.
runtime.resourcesNote: Samples the chat process every 2 seconds, excluding the server and browser. CPU 100% equals one core; samples older than 10 seconds show —.
traffic.title: Traffic analytics
traffic.heading: 📈 Traffic analytics · Observation mode
traffic.intro: Join events do not measure platform recommendations. Only received events are included; missing periods do not mean there were no viewers.
traffic.chart.viewers: Viewers (grouped by time; gaps remain empty)
traffic.chart.arrivals: Joins and chat (grouped by time; joins vary by platform)
traffic.chart.description: Drag charts horizontally to pan, or use zoom buttons. Click for bucket totals. These actions change only the analysis window, not the layout. Rate mode omits active users.
traffic.chart.gaps: Shaded areas = no data for that interval
traffic.chart.gapsNote: (offline or no samples received), which differs from zero viewers. Chat counts do not apply clip filtering rules.
traffic.history.title: Historical distribution
traffic.history.description: Brighter cells mean higher average viewers during sampled minutes; — means no viewer samples. Select a time slot for details. These are historical observations, not predictions of platform recommendations.
traffic.history.metricsNote: Engagement is summed across sessions. Cumulative audience uses the maximum because viewers can overlap between sessions.
traffic.ranking.title: Stream start time comparison (historical reference)
traffic.ranking.collecting: Collecting data — not enough time slots to compare
traffic.ranking.summary: {total} recorded sessions in this range; {usable} have usable opening observations. {qualified} time slots meet the comparison threshold.
traffic.ranking.scopeOwn: Only your own streams are counted; other streamers and test data are excluded.
traffic.ranking.scopeAll: No stream is marked as yours yet, so all sources are counted for now. Classify one under Manage streamer and session purpose below to switch to your own streams only.
traffic.ranking.criteria:
Each session needs a source-provided start time, {window} elapsed minutes, and at least {observed} observed minutes in the first {window}.
Each weekday/hour slot (a start within 15 minutes before the hour counts as the next hour) needs {minimum} sessions across {days} distinct dates.
traffic.ranking.missingStart: Missing start time: {count} sessions. Check that the source reports it; the first received message cannot substitute for it, and waiting may not recover historical data.
traffic.ranking.pending: Opening window still in progress: {count} sessions. Evaluated after 30 minutes, subject to sufficient viewer observations.
traffic.ranking.insufficientCoverage: Insufficient opening coverage: {count} sessions. Late connection, sampling gaps, or an early end may be responsible. Later samples cannot recover the missed opening.
traffic.ranking.insufficientCoverageTikT: Insufficient opening coverage: {count} sessions. TikTok can only connect after going live; a late connection, sampling gaps, or an early end may be responsible. Later samples cannot recover the missed opening.
traffic.ranking.progress: Time slot data collection progress (not a ranking)
traffic.ranking.progressItem: {slot}: {sessions} sessions / {days} dates; needs {missingSessions} more sessions and {missingDays} more dates. New sessions can satisfy both requirements.
traffic.ranking.nextUnlock: Open {sessions} more sessions to unlock the ranking
traffic.ranking.nextSecond: Open {sessions} more sessions to start ranking
traffic.ranking.nextSecondSlot: Build one more time slot to start ranking
traffic.ranking.nextOneSlot: Open {sessions} more sessions to qualify this slot
traffic.ranking.nextCollect: Collect streams with opening observations first
traffic.ranking.nextDispersedAction: {slots} slots have only one session each. Pick one or two times you want to keep and stream them three times on different dates to start comparing; constantly changing times will not accumulate.
traffic.ranking.nextActionTwo: Open {count1} more in the same slot {slot1} and {count2} more in {slot2}, on different dates (not necessarily consecutive), to start ranking.
traffic.ranking.nextActionSecond: Open {count} more in the same slot {slot} on different dates (not necessarily consecutive) to qualify a second slot.
traffic.ranking.nextActionOne: Open {count} more in the same slot {slot} on different dates (not necessarily consecutive) to qualify it; the ranking also needs a second slot.
traffic.ranking.nextWeeklyHint: If you stream these slots once a week, it takes about {weeks} weeks to unlock.
traffic.ranking.nextOtherSlotHint: Streaming at another time accumulates that other slot and does not advance the goals above.
traffic.ranking.nextActionSecondSlot: Build another time slot with at least {minimum} sessions across {days} different dates.
traffic.ranking.nextActionCollect: Start the connection before going live so at least {observed} of the first {window} minutes are observed; only sessions with a source-provided start time are included.
traffic.ranking.nextWhy: How this is calculated and why sessions are excluded
traffic.ranking.nextTipMissing: {count} sessions lack a start time and cannot be recovered; next time confirm the source reports it.
traffic.ranking.nextTipCoverage: {count} sessions have insufficient opening coverage; start the connection before going live.
traffic.ranking.nextTipCoverageTikTok: {count} sessions have insufficient opening coverage; TikTok can only connect after going live—keep the app running and confirm it connected after the start.
traffic.ranking.nextTipPending: {count} sessions are still in the opening window and will update later.
traffic.ranking.nextMinSlots: The ranking needs at least two qualifying slots.
traffic.ranking.provisionalNote: 2 sessions / 2 dates is for reference only; the formal ranking still requires 3 sessions / 3 dates and at least two qualifying slots.
traffic.ranking.assistedNote: These slots include late TikTok connections, approximate starts, or estimated starts; they are not part of the exact ranking.
traffic.ranking.assistedOnlyAction: The exact ranking requires precise starts (Twitch); assisted data can still be used for accumulation and planner recommendations.
traffic.ranking.slotBoundary: Slots use the source-provided actual start time in the selected timezone. A start within 15 minutes before the hour counts as the next hour, so 19:45–20:44 belongs to 20:00 and 19:44 remains in 19:00. Only the start time matters; crossing into the next hour does not move the session.
traffic.ranking.shortRange: Seven days cannot contain three dates for the same weekday/hour. Select Last 30 days and collect valid observations in that slot across at least three weeks.
traffic.ranking.comparison: At least two qualifying slots are needed for ranking. A single qualifying slot is shown as descriptive data only.
traffic.ranking.caution: These minimum data thresholds do not guarantee statistical reliability. Observed opening performance depends on content and other factors; it does not establish recommendation rules or causation.
traffic.detail.recent: Recent join records within the selected window (up to 200)
traffic.detail.note: Details retain only recent raw events; historical chart aggregates remain available. Empty historical details do not mean there were no joins. Native join events are currently available only for TikTok.
traffic.detail.empty: No join events received (not all platforms provide them; only native TikTok MEMBER events are supported).
traffic.detail.emptyInterval: No join events in this interval.
traffic.updateError: Update failed. Results below are from the previous update and are not current.
traffic.clean.title: 🧹 Clear statistics (remove unwanted data without resetting everything)
traffic.clean.description: Clear a whole day, part of a day, or the last N hours. Charts and history update after deletion. Sessions are selected by their start time; heartbeat records are retained.
traffic.clean.needDate: Choose a date and start/end times first.
traffic.clean.invalidEnd: End time must be after start time.
traffic.clean.speakers: Chatters (by message count; all pages available)
traffic.clean.raw: Raw events (by time; unsaved message content cannot be recovered)
traffic.clean.metricsHidden: Metrics update (values not expanded in this preview)
traffic.clean.retention: Raw events are retained for 7 days. Aggregates remain available for earlier periods; no raw events does not mean there was no data.
traffic.history.error: History failed to load. Displayed results are not current.
traffic.storageNote: Data is saved locally in SQLite and survives restarts. Charts and history use all minute aggregates; live status and join details retain up to 24 hours / 20,000 events. Native TikTok joins/chat and TikTok/Twitch viewer counts are supported; other sources must report explicitly.
traffic.chart.hint: Hover to inspect values; click or tap to pin an interval. Focus a chart and use arrow keys or Home/End to navigate; Esc clears selection.
traffic.chart.viewersLabel: Viewer chart; arrow keys change intervals, Escape clears selection
traffic.chart.arrivalsLabel: Joins and chat chart; arrow keys change intervals, Escape clears selection
traffic.chart.readout: {state}: {from} – {to} · Average viewers {viewers} · Joins {joins} · Chat {chats} · Active chatters {active}
traffic.status.stale: No fresh viewer sample (older than 90 seconds)
traffic.diagnostics: Viewer samples: {observed}/{total} intervals in range · Latest native: {native}, backup: {backup} ({samples} samples / {events} events in memory) · Blocked {blocked}/{chats} messages · Ad accounts {ads}/{active}
traffic.summary: This range has {count} viewer intervals ({minutes} minutes each), recorded even without chat. First and last sampled intervals: {from} – {to}.
traffic.summary.empty: No viewer samples in this range. Expand the range or check daily statistics below.
traffic.clean.previewCounts: {span}: {minutes} minute aggregates, {events} raw events, {chatUsers} chatter records, {sessions} sessions. The following data will be deleted:
traffic.clean.removed: Deleted: {minutes} minute aggregates, {events} raw events, {chatUsers} chatter records, {sessions} sessions ({memory} events remain in memory).
traffic.history.cell: {day} {hour}:00 · {minutes} sampled minutes over {days} days · {joins} joins and {chats} chat events recorded.
traffic.ranking.note: {sessions} sessions across {cells} slots. Ranking requires at least {minimum} sessions across 3 days, a known stream start time, and at least 20 observed minutes in the first 30 minutes. These are historical observations, not platform recommendation rules.
traffic.ranking.insufficient: No time slot meets the requirement of {minimum} sessions across 3 days with a known start time and at least 20 observed opening minutes ({sessions} sessions total). No ranking yet.
traffic.ranking.partial: Not yet qualified (needs {minimum} sessions across 3 days): {list}
traffic.ranking.unstarted: {count} sessions excluded because the source did not provide a stream start time.
traffic.overview.title: All-history overview
traffic.overview.hint: Drag the selection to pan or resize. Arrow keys pan; + / - zoom. You can also choose an observation segment.
traffic.overview.loading: Loading details for the selected period…
traffic.overview.limit: Select at most 366 days at a time.
traffic.overview.restart: Detailed queries require the updated server. Restart the server and reload.
traffic.overview.summary: Detail: {from} – {to} · Average viewers {average} · Highest minute average {peak} · {samples} samples · {minutes} minutes per interval
traffic.overview.gap: Gap since the previous segment: {hours} hours (no data).
traffic.overview.compressedNote: Hatched bands mark compressed gaps with no data. Data segments are widened for selection. Detail charts keep real time; scroll the overview horizontally when needed.
traffic.overview.realNote: The overview uses true time proportions. Hatched bands indicate no data.
traffic.window.note: Blue shows mean viewers across sampled minutes. Brighter green below indicates higher viewer sampling coverage; blank background means no samples. Drag the selection to pan, its edges to resize, or outside to select a new window. Both charts use real time. Thin green marks show the highest minute mean. Detail windows span up to 366 days; the overview covers all data.
traffic.window.quality: Viewer sampling: {observed} minutes · Unsampled: {missing} minutes · Coverage {coverage}% (minute resolution; missing samples are neither zero viewers nor proof of being offline)
traffic.browse.empty: No records in this window. This does not establish whether the stream was offline.
traffic.browse.note: Up to 6 observation segments per page. Select a card or navigate records. A segment is not necessarily a stream session. Only changing Browse mode to Free time range reveals the timeline and zoom controls.
traffic.segments.hint: Each card is an observation segment with records. Select one to view its charts below. Up to 6 per page, newest first.
traffic.design.zone: Inputs and charts use {zone}; maximum 366 days.
traffic.design.invalid: Enter valid, unambiguous local times: end must follow start, not be in the future, and span at most 366 days.
traffic.design.loading: Loading {from} – {to}. Previous results are hidden until complete.
traffic.design.failed: Window failed to load. Charts and statistics are hidden. Select a segment or apply dates to retry.
traffic.design.draft: Date edits are not applied yet. The charts still show the loaded window.
